name: Mitsuuroko Group Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Mitsuuroko Group Holdings Co.,Ltd. supplies liquefied petroleum gas and petroleum products in Japan, Singapore, and the rest of Asia. The company operates through the Energy Business, Electric power business, Foods Business, Living & Wellness Business, and Overseas Business segments. It supplies liquefied petroleum gas, liquefied natural gas, autogas, compressed natural gas for vehicles, and other petroleum products. The company also sells and installs household systems and appliances; offers fiber optic communication services; and supplies solid fuel, solar power generation systems, lithium-ion batteries, and residential-use fuel cells.
